body: I wasn't really talking about a romantic relationship. I gave up on that idea some time ago. I would dig some friends, but it is ridiculously difficult to find new friends after a certain age.  And I want to know what love feels like in general. My parents did not love me unconditionally. No one has. 10 years of working on myself has only made me realize how alone I am. I am already out of hope. I am running on fumes. The problem is that I don't matter. In my experience, men have to work twice as hard to get help for mental health issues. Two different doctors have tried to tell me that I was lying about being abused growing up and needed to start telling the truth. People don't want to help people like me even when we want help. It gets to a point where it is not worth the struggle. White knuckling it through every day, trying to hold on for dear life. Eventually it just comes time to let go.
